svg.script: (function(){var sc=document.currentScript;var svg=sc&&sc.closest?sc.closest("svg"):null;if(!svg)return;var box=svg.querySelector(".ggtree-tooltip-box");if(!box)return;var rect=box.querySelector("rect"),txt=box.querySelector("text");function pt(e){var p=svg.createSVGPoint();p.x=e.clientX;p.y=e.clientY;var c=svg.getScreenCTM();return c?p.matrixTransform(c.inverse()):{x:10,y:10};}function show(e){var el=e.target&&e.target.closest?e.target.closest("[data-tooltip]"):null;if(!el){box.setAttribute("visibility","hidden");return;}var msg=el.getAttribute("data-tooltip")||"";txt.textContent=msg;var bb=txt.getBBox();var bw=Math.max(bb.width+16,48),bh=24;rect.setAttribute("width",bw);rect.setAttribute("height",bh);var q=pt(e);var vb=svg.viewBox&&svg.viewBox.baseVal?svg.viewBox.baseVal:{width:800,height:600};var tx=Math.min(q.x+10,(vb.width||800)-bw-6);var ty=Math.max(q.y-30,4);box.setAttribute("transform","translate("+tx.toFixed(1)+","+ty.toFixed(1)+")");box.setAttribute("visibility","visible");}svg.addEventListener("mousemove",show);svg.addEventListener("mouseleave",function(){box.setAttribute("visibility","hidden");});})();
